feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 June 2026 10:26pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 03 June 2026 at 10:25pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure will track slowly eastwards across Scotland tonight, moving into the North Sea later tomorrow.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in a few places, mainly in the east of the area. Veering West or Southwest 5 or 6 later in the night & tomorrow morning, still occasionally 7 in east of the area.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate later tonight.


##Weather##

Showers, some heavy, becoming isolated later on Thursday evening.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the east, decreasing 4 or 5 later tomorrow night or at first on Friday morning. Backing Southwest later on Friday morning and afternoon, then south later in the day.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
